title: feat: add Muse Glimmer 30B
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `muse-glimmer` as a new Quest-Pollen-accessible model with no aliases or fallback.
- Pins direct Fireworks route `accounts/fireworks/models/muse-glimmer-30b` with text/image input, tools, reasoning, 131,072 context, and exact `$0.35/$0.04/$1.50` per-million input/cached-input/output pricing.
- Keeps the implementation to the registry, existing Fireworks configuration path, resolver coverage, reasoning wiring, and required pricing snapshot.

Validation:
- Direct Fireworks probes: text, image, tools, reasoning levels, streaming, prompt cache, errors, and 10/10 burst.
- Local end-to-end: all model catalogs, canonical resolution, paid-balance-zero Quest path, text, vision, tools, reasoning, streaming, cache miss/hit, errors, wallet billing, and 10/10 burst (1.28–2.45 s).
- Exact normal and streaming wallet deductions matched reported usage; the repeated output-cache hit returned in 13 ms without a second charge.
- Focused gen/enter tests: 500 passed; both typechecks and frontend build passed.

gist.headline: A glimmer joins the garden
gist.blurb: Muse Glimmer 30B has landed in the Quest-Pollen patch. It reads text and images, uses tools, reasons out loud when asked, and remembers a good cache hit.
gist.summary: Added the Quest-Pollen-accessible Muse Glimmer 30B model through Fireworks with text and image input, tool calling, reasoning controls, a 131,072-token context window, streaming, prompt caching, and pricing of $0.35/$0.04/$1.50 per million input/cached-input/output tokens.
gist.impact: Developers can now call muse-glimmer directly for long-context chat, vision, tools, and reasoning workloads, with verified wallet billing and cached repeat responses returning in as little as 13 ms without a second charge.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian-wizard bee with round glasses, tending a glowing Muse Glimmer seedling beside a cozy Fireworks-powered CRT terminal. The terminal shows small text, image, tool, and reasoning icons flowing into a large garden scroll to represent the 131K context window, while code-plants and soft cache sparkles suggest fast repeat responses.
